prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 8 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1448; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred while the vehicle was changing lanes, reporting neck pain and stiffness with headache radiating to the upper shoulders. Mechanism and force of the impact are consistent with the reported cervical injury. Over the course of eight visits, care consisted of supervised therapeutic exercise, manual therapy, and short-term anti-inflammatory medication, with visit frequency reduced steadily as symptoms improved. Cervical range of motion was restricted in flexion and rotation, with paraspinal muscle tenderness on palpation, while neurological screening, reflexes, and strength testing were within normal limits. The patient has no known prior injury or treatment involving the cervical spine or upper back. Billing records reflect single entries for each service rendered, with no duplicated charges. Patient was discharged from active care with a home exercise program and instructions to return if symptoms recur.
